description.label: Description
description.value:
Awarded For: Slaying a powerful and dangerous Beastman, Greenskin or Mutant champion such as a Beastlord, Chaos Cult Leader, or Greenskin Warboss in melee combat.

Description: A silver medallion carved in the shape of a wolf’s head with its features etched in.

Bonuses: The medal wearer’s melee attacks against Beastmen, Greenskins and Mutants, gain the Damaging Weapon Quality. Any warhammers or axes (the signature weapons of Ulric) you wield gain +1 Damage with this medal equipped. If you do not have either the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.zGQ0ShUTSlUvVtWh]{Warrior Born} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.RmY0CUjiFYZ3GEKY]{Very Resilient} Talent already, one may be added to the Talent list of any career you are in.

Automation (Wave 3): Until automated, the GM applies the bonuses above manually when the medal is worn (Imperial Honors) or when the honor applies (Kill Counts).

Medal Notes

Talents granted by medals apply only to the original recipient. Non-talent bonuses require the medal to be worn by the earner. Non-earners do not gain these benefits — the GM enforces recipient rules (no automatic earner lock). Medals can be identified with Easy (+40) Lore (Empire / Heraldry / History). Fake medals: Evaluate + Numismatics (GM difficulty).
